entries.topic: Owner authorizes D171 Agent identity mismatch repair and replacement standalone EXE release
facts: Owner requests immediate repair and publication of the independent D171 Windows EXE following D171_AUTH_IDENTITY_MISMATCH during Start; this is within the already-approved D171 scope, not a new change.

Source root cause identified: Windows EXE compared opaque Firebase app_user_id directly to the typed privileged login alias. Worker uses user_id as an internal key and resolves login via user_id OR employee_code. These are not interchangeable.

Patch accepts only the two preauthorized privileged Agent login aliases and requires the Worker-returned user_id, employee_code, firebase_uid and role to match the Firebase token app_user_id/sub/role; runtime Start/refresh must keep the exact bound UID and user_id. Mismatch still fails closed.

Synthetic offline regression tests cover opaque user_id distinct from login, swapped login, forged user_id, forged UID, role mismatch, missing identity, and changed refreshed token. Windows CI must run selftest before uploading artifact.

No change to production Worker, Firebase Rules, test collection, PDA APK, operational Agent, real WMS/Picklist, Stable, D170 or provider quotas. D169 remains last Owner-accepted base; D170 paused; D171 physical FIELD PASS still false.
